description: File one or more items into a folder of the reader's tree, e.g. when they were sorted into the wrong one. To reorganise the whole tree use driftnet_suggest_folders; to star, note or trash an item use driftnet_update_item. ids: repeated ids count once, and items already in the target folder are left as they are. The batch is all-or-nothing: if any id or the folder is unknown, nothing moves and the error names it. folder is a folder id from driftnet_list_folders, not its display name. The placement counts as the reader's own choice, so automatic sorting will never move these items again. Returns an undo id for driftnet_undo_move.

folder.description: Target folder id from driftnet_list_folders, e.g. 'coding'

ids.description: Item ids to move together, 1–500 positive integers, e.g. [42, 43]

name: driftnet_move_items
title: Move items to a folder
